observations: Stainless steel gas cooker with four burners and an oven, shown from front and side angles.
The oven door is open in all photos, revealing a wire rack inside.
The cooktop has two electric burners (flat, darkened) and two gas burners (with black caps).
The appliance has five white knobs on the front panel.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JI' and 'HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' visible on all photos.
The background shows a cluttered indoor space with other appliances and a car reflected in the glass door.

claims.claim: Neat refurbished standing Gas Cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show a clean exterior but no functional test or proof of operation. The 'perfect working condition' claim is unsupported by visual evidence.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows the motor or internal components. No evidence of when it was bought or if it has been opened.
No photo shows any receipt or warranty card. The seller claims to have them, but they are not visible in the photos.

risks.risk: The appliance may not be in perfect working condition despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the appliance in operation with all burners and oven functioning.

risks.risk: The 'motor was never opened' claim may be misleading or false, as the oven door is open in all photos, suggesting access to internal components.
risks.proof: A photo showing the interior of the oven or the motor compartment with the door closed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the motor has been opened.

risks.risk: The 'bought new last year' claim may be false or exaggerated, as there is no evidence of a purchase date or newness.
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt or a timestamped purchase document.

proof_requests: Ask for a video or photo showing the appliance in operation with all burners and oven functioning.
response.reason: The seller's claims about the condition and history of the cooker are unsupported by the photos. A video or photo demonstrating functionality is needed to verify the 'perfect working condition' claim.
